title: Good but very hard to clean
text: Good but very hard to clean. Bought for homemade fries. Sweet potatoes AB’s carrots don’t do well in this machine. The food gets jammed and stuck. Softer potatoes are great but wetter ones such as russet potatoes get stuck.  Onions and zucchini are also too wet to use.  This thing is a pain in there butt to take apart. There are tiny washers you have to deal with. I bought this product to save my hands but cleaning it is more difficult than just cutting with a knife.  The grate this product comes with makes large cuts. I wish it came with a smaller grate. The bundle option was not available when I purchased it so if you have that option, do it. Overall, I like this product but it is limited on what it can cut. It does save time for potatoes but not good on really hard or really wet foods.

product_metadata.title: Electric French Fry Cutter, Sopito Stainless Steel Potato Cutter with 1/2-Inch Blade & 3/8-Inch Blade Perfect for Potatoes Carrots Cucumbers
features: ELECTRIC FRENCH FRY CUTTER: This electric French fry cutter is designed for commercial and home use.

SHARP & DURABLE BLADES: The blade's size is 5.2 x 5.1 inches, made of premium stainless steel which is sharp and durable, can cut any raw potatoes into all 1/2 inches and 3/8inch chips as easy as pie.

EASY & SAFE TO USE: 2-button controller (Forward/Backward) on the top, when you press and hold "Forward" button gently, the cutting blade will forward to cut the potatoes; when you press and hold "Backward " button, the cutting blade will backward and then you can put another potato into it again for cutting. The whole process is effortless, simple and safe to use.

SIMPLE TO CLEAN: The cutting blade is detachable, you can disassemble it, and clean it with soft cloth and water which makes it look like a new one again. Hassle-free for cleaning. (Note: the blade is sharp, please do not wash it with your hands )
